segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi, this is Daniel from Northstar Linen. I just need a copy of our February invoice sent over. Our AP team can't find it in the shared mailbox.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can you confirm the account name and the last four digits of the billing contact phone number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Account is Northstar Linen Services, and the phone ends in 4428.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect, thank you. I'm pulling it up in the billing tool now. Looks like the February invoice is INV-184672, dated February 3, 2026, for $3,480.00.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds right. Can you send it to ap@northstarlinen.com and copy me at daniel.ross@northstarlinen.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, one moment. Okay, I sent the PDF to both addresses, and I also added a note in the ticketing system under ticket 318924.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it already. That's all I needed, thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Glad to help. Have a good rest of your day.
